column1: # Exterior body of the published-Boehm flute (Boehm 1871 as recomputed by Miller 1922, Table II, A=440 Schema rule;
# PF-661 riser area from Wolfe et al. 2001): data/instruments/geometry/flute-boehm-silver-bfoot-boehm1871.
# Body frame: x from the cork face toward the foot, the opening azimuth from +y toward +z.
# Declared simplifications (each an UNKNOWN of that set or a modelling choice):
# - rigid straight tube of outer radius 9.78 mm over its whole length (head-joint outer profile not given);
# - crown 20 mm beyond the cork (u: head end length not given);
# - every opening flush with the tube surface at azimuth pi/2 (u-hole azimuth, frames.tsv): no chimney (3.28 mm),
#   no riser (5 mm), no lip plate (u-lip-plate), no key cups or pads over open holes (u-pad-geometry);
# - embouchure as the equal-area circle of the 90 mm2 PF-661 area (Wolfe 2001; the cone gives 117 mm2);
# - foot end as a disc of the 9.5 mm bore radius on the end cap; no player.
# Rung body for the harmonics comparison: holes 01-03 (the two trill holes and the small C# hole) are closed in
# D4, G4 and A5, so as rigid patches they are identical to the wall; they are omitted because these panel steps
# cannot resolve 3.3-3.8 mm radii. Every other row is as in body-coarse.tsv.
